item.title: A cheap, low-maintenance Minecraft server for four friends — and the things that tripped me up
item.description: I wanted a survival server four friends could jump on whenever — cheap to run, and low-maintenance enough that I’d basically forget it was there. Vanilla-ish, no giant modpack, just a persistent world that stays up on its own. This is the full build start to finish, commands and all. And because the stuff that actually cost me an evening was never the stuff I expected, I’ve left every gotcha in place, right where it bit me.
